import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { Then, When } from '@cucumber/cucumber';

When('I quote shipping to {string}', function (country: string) {
  const prices = { US: 5, AU: 12 };
  this.quote = {
    price:
      process.env.BDD_CORPUS_DEFECT === '1'
        ? (country === 'US' ? 12 : 5)
        : prices[country as keyof typeof prices],
  };
});
Then('the price is {int}', function (price: number) {
  assert.equal(this.quote.price, price);
});
